text.zh: 你打进了一粒载入史册的进球，全场镜头都对准了你……
text.en: You've scored a goal for the history books; every camera is on you…

label.zh: 腾空转体，落地振臂怒吼 SIUUU
label.en: Leap, spin, land and roar — SIUUU

note.zh: C罗的标志性庆祝 —— 致敬 C罗

background.zh: C罗的「SIUUU」庆祝自 2013 年起成为标志，腾空转体、落地振臂，如今是全球争相模仿的动作。
background.en: Ronaldo's 'SIUUU' became iconic from 2013 — the leap, the spin, the arms — now copied the world over.

label.zh: 面无表情掀开球衣，露出「Why Always Me」
label.en: Lift your shirt, deadpan, to reveal 'Why Always Me'

note.zh: 致敬巴洛特利 2011 曼市德比

background.zh: 2011 年曼市德比，巴洛特利进球后面无表情掀开球衣，露出内搭的「Why Always Me」，成为永恒名场面。
background.en: In the 2011 derby Balotelli scored, then deadpan revealed an undershirt reading 'Why Always Me' — an instant classic.

label.zh: 跑向角旗，安静地指向天空，把进球献给家人
label.en: Run to the corner flag, point quietly to the sky, dedicate it to family

label.zh: 脱衣狂奔绕场一周，喜提一张黄牌
label.en: Whip your shirt off, sprint a lap, collect a yellow card
